description_en: Modifies a scene, including the layout, without invalidating the previous configurations. This operation is more efficient than the SetCasterSceneConfig operation
description_zh: 增量设置场景配置，不清空原配置，布局信息在原场景上增量修改，效率较全量设置高
kebab_example: aliyun live update-caster-scene-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id 80787064-1c94-4dc1-85ce-9409960a0000 --scene-id 242b4e2c-c30f-4442-85ba-2e3e4e3d0000 --layout-id eeab74fb-379d-4599-a93d-86d16a050000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCasterSceneConfig

parameters.help_en:
A list of component IDs. The components in the array are layered from bottom to top.

N indicates the sequence number. For example, ComponentId.1 is the ID of the first component and ComponentId.2 is the ID of the second component
parameters.help_zh:
组件ID列表，数组内按照由下至上的顺序排列组件。 N表示第几个的意思。例如：
ComponentId.1表示第1个组件ID，
ComponentId.2表示第2个组件ID
parameters.name: component_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you create a production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value from the response.

If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, find the ID on the Cloud Production Studio page. Navigate to this page by choosing Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console.

The name of the production studio in the list is its ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the layout. If you query the layout list for the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848028.html operation, use the LayoutId value from the response
parameters.help_zh: 布局ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848028.html查询导播台布局列表，请查看DescribeCasterLayouts接口调用返回的参数LayoutId值
parameters.name: layout_id
